$comment: Self-derived finetype drift contract for census/fips, checked by the in-engine finetype_validate@1 gate (the model-free `ft_validate` DuckDB table macro). ft_validate MELTS every column to VARCHAR, so this contract uses ONLY the string-surviving JSON-Schema keywords. ENFORCED: the shapes descriptor.overrides.json publishes on code, code_display, parent_code, state_code, county_code, state_abbr and gnis_code; the closed `enum` domains on level and text_source; class_code and functional_status held to the values Census's 2020 county list uses, so a new class or status fails the run for a person to describe; the release pattern; and `minLength`/`maxLength` envelopes on the names. NOT ENFORCED, by design: depth and current (a numeric or boolean `type` BACKFIRES to 100% reject once melted to VARCHAR); NULLs (invisible to ft_validate); object-level `required` (documentation only). Derived from build/stage/fips.parquet: a pass-through on today's 3,301 rows, a fail-closed tripwire for future drift.
title: census/fips
